response.text: {"title": "Our understanding of the Trust's requirements", "text": "The proposal must be sent by e-mail to the Trust's office by 17:00 GMT on 2027-02-12 as one document of no more than 15 pages [REQ-0001]. The system must keep all personal data in the United Kingdom [REQ-0008] and be live by 2027-06-30 [REQ-0012]. To meet operational needs, the system shall hold donor records with contact details and gift history [REQ-0003], record consent for e-mail, post, and telephone with dates [REQ-0004], record volunteer hours per club [REQ-0005], and send volunteers reminders two days before booked sessions [REQ-0006]. Furthermore, availability must be 99% each calendar month [REQ-0010], the supplier must train staff before going live [REQ-0011], the system should import existing donor spreadsheets without manual retyping [REQ-0007], and bidders may offer an optional mobile app for volunteers [REQ-0009].", "cited_ids": ["REQ-0001", "REQ-0008", "REQ-0012", "REQ-0003", "REQ-0004", "REQ-0005", "REQ-0006", "REQ-0010", "REQ-0011", "REQ-0007", "REQ-0009"]}
